name: B10-0542/2025 (PPE) – Escalation of the war and the humanitarian catastrophe in Sudan
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the escalation of the war and the humanitarian catastrophe in Sudan
part_text:
The European Parliament calls for an immediate end to the war in Sudan between the Sudanese Armed Forces and the Rapid Support Forces. It condemns violations of international law by both sides and demands safe, unhindered access for humanitarian aid. It asks the European Union to keep and increase its 273 million euro aid package, to impose arms embargoes and targeted sanctions, and to hold perpetrators accountable. It also urges outside countries to stop supplying weapons and support to the warring parties. The resolution is a statement of position; it does not itself change any law.

- **What changes:** Nothing directly; Parliament only states demands and positions.
- **Who it affects:** Sudan's warring parties, outside arms suppliers, and aid agencies.
- **What happens next:** The resolution is sent to the Council, Commission and other bodies for follow-up.
